people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
translations.bsb: Then he distributed to every man and woman of Israel a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake.
translations.kjv: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.
translations.asv: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a portion of flesh, and a cake of raisins.
